thread:
alexa_partnerships: Hey team, AstraGrid just signed an NDA and wants a joint POC. They need a short runbook, cost sketch (hosted vs dedicated), and answers to a security questionnaire by next Thu. Can we triage?

sam_eng: I can own the POC tech lead. Need to confirm target model, RPS, and latency SLOs. Is this 1:1 chat or batch inference?

maria_sales: Customer expects ~100 QPS peak, mostly chat use, occasional long responses (up to 1k tokens). They want pricing for a 4-week pilot and an estimate for production at 1k QPS. Budget is tight, looking for committed vs burst options.

lee_security: Quick checklist: data residency (EU), encryption at rest (KMS/HSM), SSO (SAML/SCIM), and personnel access controls. I'll start the questionnaire template and flag anything high risk.

jordan_sre: Network questions: will they connect via VPC peering or our hosted ingress? Also, egress patterns matter for cost — are model weights staying on our infra or theirs (private deployment)?

alexa_partnerships: They're asking for VPC peering for the pilot (to validate latency), but open to hosted for fast rollout. Model: public Llama-2. Chat use. SLO: 95th <= 250ms for short responses (<128 tokens).

sam_eng: OK. For the pilot I propose: 2-node dedicated pool (A100 equivalent) pinned to quantized Llama-2-13B, autoscale to 6 nodes for load test. For hosted fallback we can route to shared instances but expect higher p95.

sam_eng: Example minimal config I'll use for infra tests:

```yaml
model: llama-2-13b-q4
replicas: 2
min_replicas: 2
max_replicas: 6
autoscale_policy: cpu_based
vpc_peering: true
network_policy: restrict_inbound
cache_prefix: true
```

maria_sales: Pricing sketch (very rough):
- Hosted pilot (4 weeks): base usage + burst => ~$8k - $12k depending on token count.
- Dedicated small pool (reserved for 4 weeks): estimated $28k (GPU rental + infra) with lower per-token cost.
- Production 1k QPS baseline: reserved annual commit recommended; monthly looks like ~$45k/mo.

lee_security: On questionnaire: I'll fill in sections: encryption, incident response, SOC2, access controls. Two questions I need you to confirm: 1) Will customer keys be customer-managed (KMS) or Redwood-managed? 2) Do they require HSM-backed key material?

alexa_partnerships: AstraGrid prefers customer-managed keys (KMS) and asked about HSM for certain regulated flows.

sam_eng: We support customer KMS for Private deployments and Dedicated via KMS integration. HSM-backed keys are supported via partner HSM in Private mode — note: additional setup lead time ~2-3 weeks.

jordan_sre: For VPC peering, I'll prepare a minimal network diagram and an egress estimate. Will also add NAT / egress IP ranges they should allow.

sec-bot: Reminder: Security questionnaire due in 5 business days. Please upload draft to the shared drive and tag @lee_security when ready. :bell:

maria_sales: I'll confirm contractual questions (trial entitlements, liability cap) with legal and get a one-pager for AstraGrid finance.

lee_security: Heads-up: if they insist on HSM for pilot, cost + timeline change. I'll note that as a blocker.

alexa_partnerships: Proposed timeline:
- This week: finalize questionnaire answers + pricing sketch (maria + lee)
- Next week: infra tests with VPC peering (sam + jordan)
- Week 3: joint run with AstraGrid engineers, latency verification
- Week 4: decision point and production quote

sam_eng: I'll kick off a minimal infra PoC tomorrow and post perf numbers.

maria_sales: I'll share a clean pricing summary and the finance contact by EOD.

alexa_partnerships: Action items: @sam_eng infra lead, @lee_security questionnaire owner, @maria_sales pricing/legal. I'll coordinate AstraGrid onboarding. Thanks everyone :rocket:

sam_eng: ack :+1:

lee_security: ack, will start now.

maria_sales: ack, sending finance intro.
